metadata.title: ACME Cloud Platform — Annual Security Assessment (Rev 5)

results.title: Assessment Results for ACME Cloud Platform — Annual Security Assessment (Rev 5)
results.description: Assessment results generated from SSP ACME Cloud Platform — SSP (NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, Moderate).

risks.title: Risk for ac-4
risks.description: Control ac-4 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement: ac-4 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on information flow control policies. The SSP states: Network-level information flow controls are in place via firewall rules. Application-level data flow labeling is in progress.

risks.title: Risk for ac-6
risks.description: Control ac-6 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement: ac-6 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks. The SSP states: Least privilege is enforced at the OS and application layer. Admin account review is scheduled quarterly; last review identified 4 accounts requiring privilege reduction.

risks.title: Risk for at-3
risks.description: Control at-3 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement:
at-3 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: a. Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with the following roles and responsibilities: organization-defined roles and responsibilities:
    1. Before authorizing access to the system, information, or performing assigned duties, and frequency thereafter; and
    2. When required by system changes;
  b. Update role-based training content frequency and following events ; and
  c. Incorporate lessons learned from internal or external security incidents or breaches into role-based training. The SSP states: Role-based training is available for system administrators, security engineers, and developers. Training for data owners is under development.

risks.title: Risk for au-5
risks.description: Control au-5 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement:
au-5 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: a. Alert personnel or roles within time period in the event of an audit logging process failure; and
  b. Take the following additional actions: additional actions. The SSP states: Automated alerts are configured for SIEM pipeline failures. Manual failover to local logging is documented but not fully tested.

risks.title: Risk for cm-4
risks.description: Control cm-4 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement: cm-4 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to change implementation. The SSP states: Security impact analysis is required for all major changes. Minor change impact analysis process is not yet formalized.

risks.title: Risk for cm-8
risks.description: Control cm-8 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.

risks.title: Risk for cp-4
risks.description: Control cp-4 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement:
cp-4 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: a. Test the contingency plan for the system frequency using the following tests to determine the effectiveness of the plan and the readiness to execute the plan: organization-defined tests.
  b. Review the contingency plan test results; and
  c. Initiate corrective actions, if needed. The SSP states: Annual tabletop exercises are conducted. Full failover test is scheduled for Q2 2026 following environment migration.

risks.title: Risk for ia-3
risks.description: Control ia-3 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement: ia-3 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: Uniquely identify and authenticate devices and/or types of devices before establishing a local remote network connection. The SSP states: Managed devices use certificate-based authentication. BYOD device authentication policy is under review.

risks.title: Risk for ir-5
risks.description: Control ir-5 is not implemented, as the SSP reports before the assessment.
risks.statement: ir-5 is reported in the SSP as Deferred. The control requires: Track and document incidents. The SSP states: SIEM-based incident detection is operational. Automated response playbooks are in development for the top 5 incident types.
